newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan oil basket falls for 4th week running.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan oil basket falls for 4th week running.

text.p: The average export price for Venezuela's basket of crude oils and refined products fell for the fourth consecutive week to $18.20 per barrel, 50 cents below last Friday, the Venezuelan government said on Friday.
The average price in February so far was $19.31 per barrel, against $21.53 per barrel in January, the Energy and Mines Ministry said.
For the year so far, the basket stood at $20.64 per barrel, against a 1996 average of $18.30 and just $14.84 in 1995.

The rise in oil prices prompted the Venezuelan government to create an macroeconomic stabilisation fund which will use windfall oil revenues to stabilise government finances. Oil accounts for about 50 percent of government revenues.
